_comment: Authoritative I/O contract for every module. Do not change without notifying the whole team. See action_plan.pdf Section 9b for full explanation of each field.

module1_ocr_extraction._note: extracted_fields keys change per doc_type per config/doc_types_config.json, but the {value, confidence} wrapper shape stays identical for every field, every doc type.

module2_document_validation.checksum_pass: true | false | null (null only when mrz_format is 'none' for that doc type)
flags: list of short strings, e.g. checksum_fail, expiry_passed -- empty list when clean

module3_tampering_detection.ela_score: 0.0-1.0, how much compression-error anomaly was found
module3_tampering_detection.ela_clarity: 0.0-1.0, how trustworthy/uniform the ELA reading itself is - feeds evidence-strength axis
module3_tampering_detection._note: overall_tamper_flag is the single boolean the risk engine consumes - combining ELA/copy-move/EXIF is this module's job, not the risk engine's.

module4_face_verification.similarity: 0.0-1.0, or null if status is no_face_detected

module5_authority_reference_match._note: Every other module must run correctly even when this returns not_available - lets the whole pipeline work before Module 5 exists, or if it's cut entirely.

module6_blockchain_ledger.previous_hash: sha256 hex string of prior record, or genesis value for first record
identity_reuse_matches: list of prior record IDs when identity_reuse_flag is true, empty otherwise

contributing_flags: list of strings explaining why the score is what it is
risk_scoring_engine._note: final_recommendation is what the dashboard displays most prominently. Dashboard should never compute this logic itself, only display it.
